headline: The top 5 is the first turn of a learning loop
subline: Beyond the brief · P&I vision: every turn makes the next decision better

steps.label: Measure
steps.detail: One truth for people and AI

annotation: After 30 June: Brain learns from its results, and the loop moves to other domains.
source: Source: case study brief (Nov 2026); P&I proposal.
notes: Where this is heading. P&I is not a reporting team; it is a learning loop. Measure, find, decide, act, prove, and back to measure.

The top 5 builds the first turn: P1 measures, P2 to P4 find, and P5, Brain, decides from March. The squads, bankers and campaigns act; P&I recommends, they decide. Holdouts prove what worked and feed back into the next turn.

By 30 June the first full turn is complete. After that, Brain learns from the results of its own recommendations, and because the loop is built on one truth that people and AI can read, it can be copied to other domains of the bank.
